summary: Staff can create and publish Pages that render at /pages/{slug} and stay out of news lists and site RSS.
detailed_changes: Added a pages table and Page model with staff CRUD, publish/unpublish, and preview.
Public published pages resolve at /pages/{slug} and appear in the sitemap.
Pages are excluded from homepage, channel listings, and /rss.xml by using a separate model from posts.
affected_areas: User groups affected: staff editors; public readers of static pages
Public impact: static CMS pages can appear at /pages/{slug}
Internal impact: staff gain a Pages workspace distinct from Posts
